recognize_zh: 骨髓 core 切片中倍可見脂肪空隙之間密集浸潤中型、染色質細緻、胞質淡的單調芽樣細胞，夾雜少數巨核細胞與紅系前驅細胞，細胞間有淡粉紅色間質；形態屬芽細胞浸潤，需 CD4/CD56/CD123 染色才能歸為 BPDCN。
features: Hypercellular marrow with dense interstitial-to-diffuse infiltrate between adipocytes
Monotonous intermediate-sized cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei and fine chromatin
Small nucleoli in some cells; scant to moderate pale cytoplasm
Scattered residual megakaryocytes and small dark erythroid precursors
Eosinophilic proteinaceous/fibrillar stromal material between cells
Subcortical bony trabecula at the top of the field
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy (H&E, medium power) shows a hypercellular marrow with a dense interstitial-to-diffuse infiltrate between residual adipocytes. The infiltrate consists of monotonous intermediate-sized cells with round to slightly irregular nuclei, fine chromatin, occasional small nucleoli and scant pale cytoplasm, with interspersed eosinophilic stromal material. Scattered residual megakaryocytes and erythroid precursors are present. Findings indicate marrow involvement by a blastic neoplasm, compatible with blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm when supported by CD4, CD56, CD123 and TCF4 immunostains.

ddx.vs: Morphology overlaps, but AML is MPO, lysozyme, CD34 or CD117-positive and lacks coordinated CD123/TCF4/TCL1 with CD56.
Lymphoblasts have higher N:C ratio and are TdT-positive with PAX5/CD19 or CD3 expression.

ddx.dx: Myeloid sarcoma-like interstitial infiltrate of chronic myelomonocytic leukemia
ddx.vs: CMML shows granulocytic hyperplasia with dysplastic megakaryocytes and increased monocytes rather than a monotonous blastic infiltrate.
